reviews.name: phase15-spec-review
reviews.note: WindowPages.main overwritten by throwaway @State copies (Dock menu and notification clicks dead), pane ids reused by herdr (key by terminal), early notification clicks lost.

reviews.name: phase15-ponytail-review
reviews.note: Duplicated workspace/tab lookups, AgentRow merge, one id format for Dock and notifications; its two biggest asks (native popover, observed ledger) were wrong for this app.

reviews.name: phase15-e2e-review
reviews.note: Only one to see the real Dock had no badge, the popover reopening after a click and the button stealing the keyboard; flagged an always-true assertion and missing menu/collapsed-sidebar coverage. One stray click landed in the user's Ghostty.

reviews.name: phase15-docs-writer
reviews.note: Wrote 11 docs pages from a fact list while the reviewers ran; its four questions caught a popover/VoiceOver line and the badge scope.

reviews.name: phase15-spec-review-2
reviews.note: Dock rows did nothing (representedObject [String] cast as String: a silent no-op edit of mine), stale notifications of gone panes.

reviews.name: phase15-ponytail-review-2
reviews.note: Found the same Dock-row bug as spec-2 independently, and shrank the hover monitor and the clicked flag.

reviews.name: phase15-e2e-review-2
reviews.note: A header wait that waited for nothing, a frame read without a poll, teardown after the call it cleans.

reviews.name: phase15-spec-review-3
reviews.note: A race in its own round-2 fix: the sweep's stale state could remove a newer banner.

reviews.name: phase15-verifier
reviews.note: One stale docs line (permission asked at launch, not at first post); most of its time was waiting for make e2e.

notes: Rough screenshot sent at +22 min; layout accepted. No notification banner or Dock badge on this Mac (ad-hoc signed build); both recorded for the user. A python replace without an assert silently skipped one edit (the Dock-row bug); assert on every scripted edit.
